attempts.prompt: Create a production sprite sheet for the existing Mass Effect 1 fan RPG Relay Chronicles. This is an EDIT/DERIVATION from supplied reference images, not a game screenshot or concept illustration. Output a native 1536 x 1024 landscape RGBA image with a truly TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Exactly FOUR isolated full-body sprite drawings, arranged in 2 columns x 2 rows. Each pose must fit completely inside its own 768 x 512 cell with at least 48 pixels of empty transparent padding on all edges and around every extended weapon or limb. Clear empty gutters, no touching poses, no cropped heads/feet/fingers/weapon barrels. Orthographic three-quarter enemy view facing screen LEFT in all three upright states; prone body also head LEFT. Realistic adult body proportions, detailed pre-rendered HD game sprite materials, crisp readable silhouette, soft neutral upper-left lighting, no pixel art, no chibi. Do not copy text, borders, other characters, scenes or interface elements from either reference. Do not add text, labels, arrows, numbers, effects, smoke, magic rings, particles, ground planes or cast shadows outside the body. Keep body identity, anatomy, palette, armor and camera consistent across all four poses. Exactly one subject per cell. Do not include any other enemy from the reference atlas. SUBJECT: ONLY the standard ME1 GETH TROOPER / Soldat geth, the ivory-gray robot in TOP LEFT of the first supplied atlas, with a single blue-white circular optic on a long angled geth head, dark flexible neck tubes, pale ivory segmented shell over dark mechanical joints, thin reverse-jointed mechanical legs and three claw-like toes. The second reference is the official Prima ME1 page 66, whose named Geth Trooper bust provides a partial identity/optic reference; retain the existing atlas palette and full-body mechanical silhouette, without importing unrelated text or figures. Keep this a standard slender infantry geth, NOT the red sniper, bulky destroyer, Legion, krogan or a human in armor. Use ONE CONSISTENT existing generic geth rifle silhouette in every armed pose, not multiple human weapon models. CELL ORDER: TOP LEFT aim = ready, stable two-handed rifle aim toward screen LEFT with both feet grounded. TOP RIGHT power = guarded braced action stance, rifle held low across the chest and free palm slightly extended forward as a restrained mechanical gesture, no hologram, no energy, no new equipment. BOTTOM LEFT hit = recoiling from a hit, knees bent and torso pulled back but both feet on the same ground baseline, rifle retained securely, no damage gore or effects. BOTTOM RIGHT down = intact motionless robot lying fully on its side at ground level, head LEFT and feet RIGHT, rifle lying held close to its body. The prone pose must be horizontal and compact but show the complete robot and rifle entirely within its cell. Preserve identity and exact armor color for every pose. These are four discrete fixed key poses, not a movement strip.
attempts.result: Four complete fixed key poses; measured irregular frame rectangles, native transparency and low-alpha fringe retained.

partialPrimaryReference.scope: Named small bust and local textual context only; no complete body/costume geometry certified.
